description: This file defines a generic ReadWriteLock class for managing transaction-based read/write locking with support for lock groups, conflict detection, and timeout handling within Orleans transactions.

classes.name: ReadWriteLock`1
classes.description: A generic class implementing a read/write lock with transaction support, conflict detection, and timeout management.

classes.name: LockGroup
classes.description: A nested class representing a group of non-conflicting transactions, managing lock acquisition, waiting tasks, and deadlines.

methods.name: EnterLock
methods.description: Asynchronously attempts to acquire a lock for a transaction, executing the provided task upon success, with conflict detection and rollback handling.

methods.name: ValidateLock
methods.description: Validates the lock status for a transaction, performing rollback if validation fails.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Signals the lock worker to re-evaluate lock state.

methods.name: TryGetRecord
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the transaction record for a given transaction ID.

methods.name: AbortExecutingTransactions
methods.description: Aborts all currently executing transactions in the current lock group.

methods.name: BreakLock
methods.description: Logs and notifies the queue to abort a specific transaction lock.

methods.name: AbortQueuedTransactions
methods.description: Aborts all queued transactions waiting in the current lock group.

methods.name: Rollback
methods.description: Performs a rollback for a specific transaction, optionally notifying remote listeners.

methods.name: LockWork
methods.description: Background task managing lock expiration, group transitions, and timeout handling.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds or creates a lock group for a transaction, considering conflicts and group size constraints.

methods.name: HasConflict
methods.description: Determines if a transaction conflicts with others in a lock group based on read/write status and priorities.

methods.name: Conflicts
methods.description: Enumerates transaction IDs that conflict with a given transaction within a lock group.

methods.name: LockExits
methods.description: Checks if the current lock group can exit, either by single transaction or multiple transactions, based on commit status.

methods.name: Comparer
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting transactions based on timestamps.
